purpose: One independent Spark supplement for #901 sibling-window RAND arguments. Input only; no expected outcomes.

definitions.sql: SELECT row_id,lag(rand(7),1) OVER (ORDER BY row_id DESC) AS previous_desc,lag(rand(7),1) OVER (ORDER BY row_id ASC) AS previous_asc FROM rand901_one
definitions.purpose: Each RAND argument belongs to the same original input, before either generated sibling Window sort.

comparison_contract.native_input_partitions: Exactly the authored partitions, including row order within each partition. Do not distribute record batches round-robin across these partitions.
comparison_contract.native_batch_layouts: Vary record-batch boundaries inside each fixed partition: [4], [1,1,1,1], [2,2], with optional empty batches. Keep complete raw results.
comparison_contract.spark_output_order: Preserve every row in collect order. Compare by row_id where present, otherwise as a multiset; do not add ORDER BY to the query under test.
comparison_contract.existing_frozen_references: The original sealed #901 r1 packet and raw observations are unchanged. This supplement writes only under sibling/spark-reference-r1.
